name: DONEPECIL 10 MG 28 TABLETS
description: Donepezil 10 mg 28 tablets by AMSA is a prescription medication used for the treatment of dementia, especially dementia associated with Alzheimer’s disease. The usual dose is 10 mg once a day, taken orally, usually at night before bedtime. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions and not increase the dose without their consent. Additional Information: Donepezil is a cholinesterase inhibitor, which means it helps increase levels of acetylcholine in the brain, a chemical that aids in communication between nerve cells. This medication may help improve symptoms of Alzheimer’s disease, such as memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes. It is important to inform your doctor about all the medications you are taking, including over-the-counter medications and supplements, before starting treatment with donepezil. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
